text:
emma_sales: Handoff: Heliograph Diagnostics - 90d pilot signed (PO in). Go-live target 2025-07-07. Requirements: HIPAA compliance, SAML SSO, private control plane in us-west-2 or dedicated GPUs, Splunk log forwarding, low token leakage. Traffic: ~8k tokens/day, peak ~5 concurrent sessions. Customer contact: ben@heliograph.io. Docs: https://share.red/heliograph-pilot

noor_cs: I'll own onboarding and run kickoff. Quick clarifiers: 1) Do they require strict FIPS/HSM for keys? 2) Any integration with their EMR API?

emma_sales: Yes on HSM (customer legal insisted). They want EMR integration later but not in pilot. For pilot just SSO + private control plane + audit logs.

dan_support: Opening infra ticket. Need SAML metadata, VPC CIDR for peering, Splunk HEC URL + token, and proof of signed BAA. Provision ETA 3 business days after artifacts.

kai_eng: Perf note: with 5 concurrent sessions and avg 600 tokens/session p99 should be fine on private control plane if we warm a small dedicated pool during 9am-3pm PT. Send expected concurrency window. Also request eval prompt set.

noor_cs: Action owners: CS/noor_cs (customer comms, rollout), Support/dan_support (infra + tickets), Eng/kai_eng (sizing + canary), Security/rita_security (BAA + HSM config), Sales/emma_sales (contracts + pricing).

rita_security: I need the signed BAA and the DLP questionnaire. HSM provisioning adds ~4 business days. Also request confirmation on retention period for logs (default 90 days), customer asked 365 days — may need compliance add-on.

infra-bot: ticket CS-3098 created by dan_support - infra.provision.privateplane

noor_cs: Checklist to send to customer:
```
- Signed BAA (scan)
- SAML IdP metadata XML
- VPC CIDR and peering contact
- Splunk HEC endpoint + token (if forwarding)
- Eval prompt set (~40 prompts)
- Canary rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows
```

emma_sales: Renewal risk: medium-high (pilot is gating expansion; if latency or security delays occur they may push). Sales will monitor weekly; escalate if blockers >5 business days.

noor_cs: I'll set up weekly health checks and a shared tracker. If infra or security blocks exceed 7 business days, escalate to Head of CS. Kickoff scheduled Mon 2025-06-16 11:00am PT.

kai_eng: Once we get eval set, I'll run a perf sim and validate q8 quant quality. If key prompts degrade >3% we should skip quant for canary.

emma_sales: Thanks all — looping customer in to collect artifacts today.
